name: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
where: Colorado Springs, CO · Norris Penrose Event Center
headline: CHSAA State Cross Country Championships
summary: The deepest state final of the week. Niwot (No. 4 boys, No. 7 girls), No. 8 Boulder and No. 9 ThunderRidge girls, plus Northfield's Abdi Hassan (No. 2 nationally), Coronado's Oliver Horton (No. 10) and Eaton's Delaney Reuter (No. 9 girls).
